rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Very steep short kerb with houses 5-13m away on the same side.

drivers.seclusion: Houses front directly onto the south kerb: 5m at 22m, apartments 10m at 14m, a house 13m at the start. Townhouses across the road 17m+.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a few cars parked along the kerb in the imagery, so room exists, but the grade is severe.
drivers.traffic: Residential street with through traffic; no signs.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb, but it is a dense residential strip with no overnight convention.

sun_shade: Mostly open; small trees give light shade; houses on the south side shade in the afternoon.

best_section.where: Prospect Terrace south kerb at the eastern end, beside the corner lots
